answer_1.quote: Meeting summarization ... generate summaries of entire meetings based on meeting transcripts.

answer_2.quote: We use standard ROUGE F-1 score to evaluate different models.

answer_4.quote: Annotators are asked to score the difficulty of this query in two dimensions... For error analysis, 10 graduate students reviewed each summary and judged factual consistency and relevance to the query.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators score difficulty of locating information (1-3) and difficulty of organizing content (1-3); they also judge factual consistency and relevance of generated summaries to the query.
